# dispatch 0.2.0

The upstream manifest at revision `82d6c7a5b75dc0c71c3f46f87bb6c16a476f7748`
lists Steven Sheldon as the author and declares MIT. The manifest is reproduced
in `Cargo.toml.orig`. The published crate and the recorded upstream revision
omit a standalone license file and a copyright line.

`MIT-SPDX.txt` reproduces the standard MIT text from SPDX with its original
placeholder. The text is a reference for the declared license. Upstream did
not supply the placeholder values.

- [Upstream manifest](https://github.com/SSheldon/rust-dispatch/blob/82d6c7a5b75dc0c71c3f46f87bb6c16a476f7748/Cargo.toml)
- [SPDX MIT text](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/blob/v3.27.0/text/MIT.txt)
